Constructor: deploys router/pair, sets fees, limits, exclusions and mints the entire supply.
onlyOwner: irreversibly enables trading, swapping and records block.timestamp.
onlyOwner: permanently disables max transaction / max wallet limits.
onlyOwner: permanently disables the tx.origin based transfer delay.
onlyOwner: updates the swap threshold with bounds derived from totalSupply.
onlyOwner: updates maxTransactionAmount with a lower bound.
onlyOwner: updates maxWallet with a lower bound.
onlyOwner: sets the max-transaction exclusion flag for an address.
onlyOwner: toggles the swapEnabled flag.
onlyOwner: rewrites buy fee components and requires total <= 20.
onlyOwner: rewrites sell fee components and requires total <= 25.
onlyOwner: sets fee exclusion for an account.
onlyOwner: marks/unmarks an AMM pair, forbidding removal of the canonical pair.
Private helper writing automatedMarketMakerPairs and emitting an event.
onlyOwner: replaces the marketing wallet address.
onlyOwner: replaces the dev wallet address.
Overridden transfer: enforces limits, tx.origin delay, triggers swapBack/auto burn and computes fees.
Private: approves router and swaps contract tokens for ETH via the router.
Private: approves router and adds ETH/token liquidity, sending LP to dead address.
Private: swaps accumulated fees, splits ETH and pays dev/marketing wallets via low-level calls.
onlyOwner: configures LP burn frequency, percent and enable flag.
Internal: transfers pair tokens to dead address and calls pair.sync().
onlyOwner: manually burns a percentage of pair tokens after cooldown and calls pair.sync().
Public view returning the fee-exclusion flag of an account.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, minting recipient and fee exclusion reads.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for LP burn scheduling and router deadlines.
Origin address used as the key for the per-block transfer delay mapping in _transfer.
address(devWallet).call{value: ethForDev}("") low-level ETH transfer whose success is ignored.
address(marketingWallet).call{value: address(this).balance}("") low-level ETH transfer whose success is ignored.

External payable call to uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH with zero minimums.
External call to IUniswapV2Pair(uniswapV2Pair).sync() on a caller-influenceable pair state.

edges.reason: Constructor uses msg.sender as the mint recipient of the total supply.
Constructor invokes _mint to create the entire token supply.
Transfers are initiated by the caller and msg.sender reaches _transfer through _msgSender in ERC20.transfer/transferFrom.
_transfer indexes _holderLastTransferTimestamp with tx.origin to rate-limit purchases per block.
_transfer writes and reads _holderLastTransferTimestamp keyed by tx.origin.
enableTrading stores block.timestamp into lastLpBurnTime, making burn timing miner-influenced.
_transfer compares block.timestamp against lastLpBurnTime + lpBurnFrequency to trigger auto burn.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router swap deadline.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the router deadline.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens records lastLpBurnTime from block.timestamp.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens compares and stores block.timestamp against the cooldown.
_transfer sets swapping=true, calls swapBack, which performs external calls before finishing state updates.
_transfer conditionally triggers autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens on eligible sells.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth while the swapping flag is the only guard.
swapBack calls addLiquidity before distributing remaining ETH.
swapBack forwards ETH to devWallet via an unchecked low-level call that can reenter.
swapBack forwards the entire remaining balance to marketingWallet via an unchecked low-level call.
swapTokensForEth makes an external router call that can invoke attacker-controlled pair logic.
addLiquidity makes an external router call with zero slippage protection.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls sync() on the pair after burning tokens.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls sync() on the pair after burning tokens.
_transfer reads and toggles the swapping guard flag.
_transfer accumulates fee shares into tokensForLiquidity using mul/div on amount.
_transfer accumulates fee shares into tokensForMarketing using mul/div on amount.
_transfer accumulates fee shares into tokensForDev using mul/div on amount.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFees to bypass limits and fees.
_transfer reads automatedMarketMakerPairs to classify buys and sells.
_transfer enforces amount <= maxTransactionAmount when limits are active.
_transfer enforces balanceOf(to) + amount <= maxWallet when limits are active.
_transfer compares the contract balance against swapTokensAtAmount.
enableTrading permanently sets tradingActive=true.
enableTrading permanently sets swapEnabled=true.
enableTrading initialises lastLpBurnTime from block.timestamp.
removeLimits sets limitsInEffect=false, an owner-only privilege.
disableTransferDelay sets transferDelayEnabled=false, an owner-only privilege.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount writes the swap threshold after owner-only bounds checks.
updateMaxTxnAmount writes maxTransactionAmount, owner-only.
updateMaxWalletAmount writes maxWallet, owner-only.
updateSwapEnabled toggles swapEnabled, owner-only.
updateBuyFees rewrites buy fee configuration, owner-only.
updateSellFees rewrites sell fee configuration, owner-only.
excludeFromFees mutates _isExcludedFromFees, gated by onlyOwner.
excludeFromMaxTransaction mutates _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount, gated by onlyOwner.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates to the private setter after checking onlyOwner.
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes the automatedMarketMakerPairs mapping.
updateMarketingWallet replaces the marketing fee recipient, owner-only.
updateDevWallet replaces the dev fee recipient, owner-only.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes lpBurnFrequency, owner-only.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes percentForLPBurn, owner-only.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes lpBurnEnabled, owner-only.
Constructor assigns the immutable uniswapV2Router.
Constructor creates and assigns the immutable uniswapV2Pair.
Constructor chain sets _owner to msg.sender through Ownable, establishing the privileged role.
The from parameter drives all limit, exclusion and fee branches in _transfer.
The to parameter drives buy/sell classification and wallet limits in _transfer.
The amount parameter is compared against limits and reduced by fees.
amount is multiplied by total fee percentages to derive the local fees value.
The computed fees are transferred to the contract and subtracted from amount.
The local contract token balance determines whether swapBack is triggered.
The capped contract balance drives liquidity/swap ETH computations in swapBack.
ethForDev is derived and then forwarded to the devWallet low-level call.
ethForMarketing is derived from the swapped ETH balance.
ethForLiquidity is the residual ETH passed to addLiquidity.
ethForDev is supplied as the value of the unchecked devWallet call.
ethForMarketing feeds the marketing distribution path whose call value is the remaining balance.
The tokenAmount parameter is approved and passed to the router swap.
amountToBurn is derived from the pair balance and burned to the dead address.
The newAmount parameter is bounds-checked then written to swapTokensAtAmount.
The percent parameter is bounded and used to compute the manual burn amount.
tokenAmount is approved and supplied to addLiquidityETH.
ethAmount is forwarded as msg.value to addLiquidityETH.
